author: Hirananda Sastri

author: Bhattasali

note: Inscription naming Samatata found in Tippera: fixes the country E of the Brahmaputra and supports Mizutani's Bad-Kamta near Comilla against the Jessore/Bikrampur placings in the notes (10.06 note should cite this). For Shi-li-ch'a-ta-lo see 173.

author: Bhattasali
asr_identification: Sri-Chattala = Chittagong

author: Bhattasali

name_in_asr: Dhanyakataka (fragmentary Asokan pillar inscription at Amaravati)
asr_identification: Dharanikota near Amaravati; Kalinga capital probably Mukhalingam
evidence: fragment of an Asokan pillar edict at Amaravati suggests the great stupa was Asoka's
quote: Hiuen-tsang also visited the headquarters of the country called T’e-na-ka-che-ka (i.e. Dhanyakataka, ३.९, Dharanikota near Amaravati) or Ta-An-to-lo (i.e. Great Andhra).
note: Agrees with Mizutani (Dharanikota); footnote favours Mukhalingam for the Kalinga capital (contrast 280).

author: D. C. Sircar
asr_identification: Und near Attock
quote: at Udabhanda or Udabbindapura (modern Und near Atteck).

author: Mirashi & L. P. Pandeya
asr_identification: court of Maha-Sivagupta Balarjuna (590-650), Somavamsi king of Kosala
evidence: Bonda plates found 1959 on the right bank of the Mahanadi, Sarangarh tahsil, Raigarh district
quote: He was probably the king of Késala who submitted to Pulakésin IT as stated in the latter's Aihole inscription. It was evidently to his court that Hiuen-tsang paid a visit during his itinerary.
note: Dynasty attested in upper Mahanadi at Xuanzang's date; agrees with Mizutani and the notes (Sirpur).

author: D. C. Sircar
asr_identification: modern Vadnagar in N Gujarat
quote: Anandapura, i.e. modern Vadnagar in Northern Gujarat

note: Sasanka king of Karnasuvarna in passing; no location.

author: D. C. Sircar & J. Sundaram
name_in_asr: Anartapura (Amreli plates of Dhruvasena II); Anandapura
asr_identification: Anandapura = Vadnagar (Mehsana); Anartapura a separate place
evidence: Anandapura named in five Maitraka inscriptions
quote: Anartapura is identified by some with Dvarakaé and by others with Anandapura (Vadnagar in the Mehsana District).

note: Asoka's relic stupas in general; no location.
